title: OpenAI to keep paying Microsoft a revenue share through 2030, now capped

sources.quote: Revenue share payments from OpenAI to Microsoft continue through 2030, independent of OpenAI’s technology progress, at the same percentage but subject to a total cap.

explain: In an April 2026 rewrite of their partnership, OpenAI agreed to keep sending Microsoft a share of its revenue through 2030, up to a total cap that was not disclosed. Microsoft stopped paying its own revenue share to OpenAI, and OpenAI became free to sell its products on any cloud.
